phase_meta.summary: Add a VVB-report-faithful presentation layer that separates conformance checklist conclusions from formal finding/request records without changing Quick Check router semantics.
current_focus: Preserve Quick Check internal statuses as machine truth
Model VVB-style checklist conclusions separately from finding records
Prevent CONFORMS from being treated as a finding type
Prepare gap report to consume this presentation model

phase_0_report_terminology_contract.title: Phase 0: Real VVB Report Terminology Contract
phase_0_report_terminology_contract.summary: Document real report language: checklist conclusions use conformance values, while NCR/NIR/OFI/CAR/CR/FAR are action findings or requests.

phase_1_status_consumer_audit.title: Phase 1: Status Consumer Audit
phase_1_status_consumer_audit.summary: Inventory every consumer of FOUND, UNCLEAR, MISSING, answered, unclear, and no_evidence before adding presentation fields.

phase_2_conformance_conclusion_contract.title: Phase 2: Conformance Conclusion Contract
phase_2_conformance_conclusion_contract.summary: Define when final validated Quick Check evidence may produce a CONFORMS checklist/narrative conclusion.

phase_3_action_finding_contract.title: Phase 3: Action Finding Contract
phase_3_action_finding_contract.summary: Define when weak, missing, non-blocking, or future-period issues produce NIR, NCR, OFI, CAR, CR, or FAR style finding records.

phase_4_applicability_contract.title: Phase 4: Applicability Contract
phase_4_applicability_contract.summary: Ensure NOT_APPLICABLE is derived only from an explicit applicability decision, not from missing or unclear evidence.

phase_5_report_presentation_object.title: Phase 5: Report Presentation Object
phase_5_report_presentation_object.summary: Add a shared object with internalStatus, conformanceConclusion, findingType, requirement reference, document reference, finding text, and auditor response.

phase_6_presentation_gates.title: Phase 6: Presentation Gates
phase_6_presentation_gates.summary: Prevent weak or placeholder evidence from displaying as CONFORMS and prevent missing evidence from becoming NCR/CAR without applicability and coverage checks.

phase_7_fixture_expectation_migration.title: Phase 7: Fixture Expectation Migration
phase_7_fixture_expectation_migration.summary: Migrate fixtures so non-FOUND statuses preserve weak or placeholder document evidence instead of nulling evidence when evaluated text exists.

phase_8_gap_report_and_ui_consumers.title: Phase 8: Gap Report and UI Consumers
phase_8_gap_report_and_ui_consumers.summary: Update gap report, UI, reports, and PDFs to consume the VVB report presentation object instead of inventing their own labels.

phase_9_deprecation_review.title: Phase 9: Deprecation Review
phase_9_deprecation_review.summary: Decide whether old user-facing labels can be hidden while keeping internal statuses permanently available for debugging and gates.
